courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Elementary Japanese I
courses.description: Introduction to listening, speaking, reading, and writing in Japanese and to the culture of Japanese-speaking regions.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Elementary Japanese II
courses.description: Continued listening, speaking, reading, and writing in Japanese with further study of the culture of Japanese-speaking regions.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Intermediate Japanese I
courses.description: A rapid review of grammar with continued use of listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills in Japanese, all with a cultural emphasis.

restrictions.heading: Cannot be enrolled in one of the following Levels
Must be enrolled in one of the following Campuses

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Intermediate Japanese II
courses.description: This course focuses on listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills in Japanese in an introduction to literature and within a cultural context.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Advanced Japanese I
courses.description: Learn advanced grammar structures and develop the ability to produce longer conversations involving complex styles and levels of speech. More kanji.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Popular Culture in Japan
courses.description: This course introduces students to Japanese society, history, and language through popular culture. Repeatable for credit if taken with different course theme. Taught in English.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Technical and Scientific Japanese
courses.description: Reading of intermediate/advanced technical and scientific Japanese texts. Analysis and discussion of scientific issues in society. Part of the Japanese intensive summer language program. Admission by application only.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Business Japanese
courses.description: Acquisition of business terminology, protocols, decorum strategies, and improvement of oral communication skills. Reading and writing of notes, correspondence, and reports. Part of the Japanese intensive summer language program. Admission by application only.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Japan Today
courses.description: Development of awareness toward cultural differences and potential communication problems through exploration of current socio-economic and corporate-cultural issues in Japan. Part of the Japanese intensive summer language program. Admission by application only.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Conversation Practicum
courses.description: Students practice conversations with native Japanese speakers to expand the repertoire of active vocabulary and grammar patterns and improve their conversational skills. Taught in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Japanese Readings on Sustainability Issues and Societal Changes
courses.description: Through extensive and intensive readings on sustainability and social changes in Japan, students will analyze and evaluate those topics in Japanese. Taught in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Special Topics
courses.description: Topics of current interest in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Advanced reading and Listening in Japanese
courses.description: This course introduces advanced grammar and stylistic and idiomatic expressions in Japanese in both written and spoken contexts on a wide range of topics.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Technical and Business Japanese Translation
courses.description: This is an applied language course that provides practical experience in translating technical and business documents to and from Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Introduction to Japanese Literature and Culture
courses.description: This is an introductory course in Japanese literature and culture where students read and interpret authentic literary texts and learn and discuss key cultural concepts. Conducted in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Critical Readings in Japanese Culture and Arts
courses.description: This course helps improve reading skills of advanced learners by analyzing various written texts on topics of culture and society. Taught in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Japanese Culture and Society through Anime
courses.description: Students will be able to appreciate anime's significance in historical, societal and cultural contexts, as well as the aesthetic quality of its form. Taught in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Japanese Culture and Society through Songs
courses.description: Students will be exposed to songs in different historical, societal and cultural contexts of Japan, and appreciate their aesthetic quality. Taught in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Japanese Culture & Society through Documentaries
courses.description: The course explores Japanese culture, language, society, and history through documentary films. Taught in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Designing Websites in Japanese
courses.description: This course provides instruction in text input in Japanese and explores language and intercultural communication issues when designing Web pages in Japanese. Taught in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: CALI Pedagogy for Japanese
courses.description: This course explores pedagogical issues in designing Computer-Assisted Language Instruction (CALI) programs for teaching Japanese. Taught in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: 3D RPG Development for Japanese Instruction
courses.description: This course explores pedagogical issues in designing Japanese instructional materials based on the 3D, RPG platform of Second Life. Taught primarily in Japanese. Prerequisites: JAPN 3002 ( JAPN 4231 and JAPN 4233 are highly recommended).

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Advanced Intercultural Seminar
courses.description: Integrates cross-cultural research and reflection into discussion of current issues in Japan. Intended for students who have had some study-abroad experience in Japan. Conducted mostly in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Japanese Internship
courses.description: Professional experience with a business/organization in which students enhance their language skills and cultural knowledge in Japanese in relation to the practical goals/objectives of the entity.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Undergraduate Research
courses.description: Independent research conducted under the guidance of a faculty member.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Japanese Discourse and Grammar
courses.description: This course is about Japanese spoken and written discourse, designed for acquiring skills for managing interpersonal relationships through advanced discourse.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Japanese Applied Linguistics
courses.description: This course helps develop analytical skills to better understand human languages, particularly English and Japanese. Credit not allowed for both JAPN 4780 and LING 4780.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Sociolinguistics through Manga
courses.description: This course explores history of manga and analyzes the gender, speech style, mimetic words, slang, and dialects through examples of Japanese manga. Taught in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Japanese Applied Linguistics for Graduate Students
courses.description: This course examines current linguistic theories as applied to Japanese in order to acquire analytical skills to better understand human languages, particularly Japanese and English.

courses.subject: JAPN

courses.description: The course focuses on theories and practice of technical and business Japanese translation. Taught in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Japanese Domestic Internship
courses.description: Students complete domestic internships. Conducted in Japanese. Online course. 3 credits.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Intercultural Seminar
courses.description: Integrates cross-cultural research and reflection into discussion of current issues in Japan. For students who have had some study/work-abroad experience in Japan. Conducted in Japanese.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Applied Language Practicum
courses.description: Students will serve as researchers, student aides and apprentice instructors for any 3/4000-level undergraduate course approved by their adviser and the course.

courses.subject: JAPN
courses.title: Applied Language Practicum Abroad
courses.description: Students serve as researchers and apprentice instructors in the LBAT or other faculty-led overseas language immersion program of the School of Modern Languages.

courses.title: Japanese Internship Abroad
courses.description: Japanese Internship Abroad.

courses.title: Japanese Discourse and Grammar
courses.description: The course is designed to improve students’ knowledge of Japanese discourse and grammar through activities using TV drama clips, documentaries, and newspaper which are related to some of SDGs. Taught in Japanese.
